summary: Preserve u-mode parsing and code-point matching instead of legacy UTF-16-code-unit RegExp behavior.

target.notes: The u flag changes grammar validation, escape interpretation, and matching iteration to Unicode code points while observable String indices remain code-unit based.

caveats: u and v are mutually exclusive.
Without u/v, dot may match one half of a surrogate pair.

tests.name: legacy dot sees two code units
